column1: # term|English example|Chinese translation
assessment|Continuous assessment gives teachers opportunities to identify difficulties early, rather than discovering them only after the final examination.|持续性考核让教师有机会及早发现困难，而不必等到期末考试后才发现。
literacy|Improving adult literacy can make public information more accessible, but documents also need to be written in clear and practical language.|提高成人读写能力可以让公共信息更易理解，但文件本身也需要使用清楚实用的语言。
numeracy|Basic numeracy helps people compare loan offers and interpret everyday statistics, making it relevant well beyond the mathematics classroom.|基本计算能力有助于人们比较贷款方案、理解日常统计，因此其价值远不止于数学课堂。
tuition|Higher tuition fees may discourage applicants who are uncertain about the financial benefits of obtaining a degree.|更高的学费可能使那些不确定取得学位能带来多大经济收益的申请者却步。
scholarship|The scholarship covers tuition and accommodation, allowing students from low-income households to participate in the full academic year.|这项奖学金涵盖学费和住宿费，让低收入家庭的学生能够参加完整学年的学习。
enrolment|University enrolment increased after evening classes were introduced, particularly among adults who combined study with paid employment.|开设晚间课程后，大学注册人数上升，尤其是在兼顾学习与有偿工作的成年人中。
drop out|Students may drop out of a course because they cannot meet living costs, even when their academic performance is strong.|即使学业表现良好，学生也可能因为无法负担生活费用而中途退学。
discipline|Students from different academic disciplines approached the same environmental problem with different assumptions about what should be measured.|来自不同学科的学生，对同一个环境问题应测量什么持有不同的预设。
feedback|Specific feedback on the structure of an argument can help students revise their writing more effectively than a mark alone.|针对论证结构的具体反馈，比单独给出一个分数更能帮助学生有效修改写作。
critical thinking|Critical thinking involves examining the assumptions behind a claim as well as deciding whether the evidence is relevant and sufficient.|批判性思维既包括检查主张背后的假设，也包括判断证据是否相关且充分。
lifelong learning|Lifelong learning becomes more feasible when adults can take short courses without leaving employment or committing to a full degree.|当成年人可以在不离职、也不必承诺完成整个学位的情况下参加短期课程时，终身学习会更可行。
innovation|The innovation reduced water use in the factory, but wider adoption depended on whether smaller firms could afford the initial investment.|这项创新降低了工厂用水量，但能否广泛采用取决于较小企业是否负担得起初期投资。
automation|Automation can remove repetitive tasks while creating demand for workers who can maintain equipment and interpret the data it produces.|自动化可以减少重复性任务，同时创造对能够维护设备并解读其数据的员工的需求。
algorithm|The algorithm ranked applications using past decisions, which raised concerns that it might reproduce existing inequalities.|该算法依据过去的决策给申请排序，这引发了它可能复制现有不平等的担忧。
privacy|Protecting data privacy requires organisations to explain why information is collected and how long it will be retained.|保护数据隐私要求组织解释为什么收集信息，以及信息将被保留多久。
cybersecurity|Investment in cybersecurity includes staff training because technically secure systems can still be compromised by misleading messages.|网络安全投入包括员工培训，因为技术上安全的系统仍可能被误导性消息攻破。
digital literacy|Digital literacy includes evaluating online information and understanding privacy settings, rather than simply knowing how to operate a device.|数字素养包括评估在线信息、理解隐私设置，而不只是知道如何操作设备。
accessibility|The service improved accessibility by offering captions and keyboard navigation, making it easier for more people to use the same materials.|该服务通过提供字幕和键盘导航改善了无障碍使用条件，让更多人更容易使用相同材料。

artificial intelligence|Artificial intelligence can identify patterns in large datasets, but its predictions depend on the quality and relevance of the training data.|人工智能可以识别大型数据集中的模式，但其预测取决于训练数据的质量与相关性。
reliability|The researchers tested the reliability of the questionnaire by checking whether repeated measurements produced reasonably consistent results.|研究人员通过检查重复测量是否产生合理一致的结果，检验了问卷的可靠性。
biodiversity|Protecting biodiversity involves maintaining relationships between species as well as preventing individual species from disappearing.|保护生物多样性既需要维持物种间的关系，也需要防止单个物种消失。
ecosystem|Changes in one part of an ecosystem can affect species elsewhere, especially when they depend on the same source of food or water.|生态系统某一部分的变化会影响其他地方的物种，尤其是在它们依赖同一食物或水源时。
habitat|Restoring a habitat requires attention to its soil and water conditions, rather than simply planting the species that once lived there.|恢复栖息地需要关注其土壤和水分条件，而不能只重新种植曾在那里生长的物种。
emission|The report distinguishes emissions produced within the city from those associated with goods imported for its residents.|报告区分了城市内部产生的排放与居民进口消费品所关联的排放。
renewable|Renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels, although electricity networks may need investment to manage variable generation.|可再生能源可以降低对化石燃料的依赖，但电网可能需要投资，以应对发电量变化。
sustainable|A sustainable transport policy must consider long-term maintenance costs as well as the environmental benefits of new infrastructure.|可持续交通政策必须既考虑新基础设施的环境效益，也考虑长期维护成本。
conservation|Conservation programmes are more likely to last when residents see how protecting local habitats can support their livelihoods.|如果居民理解保护当地栖息地如何支持生计，保护计划就更可能持续下去。
recycling|Improving recycling rates may require simpler collection rules and reliable markets for recovered materials, rather than publicity alone.|提高回收率可能需要更简单的收集规则和可靠的再生材料市场，而不能只靠宣传。
landfill|Reducing the amount of food sent to landfill can lower waste-disposal demand while encouraging better planning of production and consumption.|减少送往填埋场的食物，既能降低废物处置需求，也能促进更好地规划生产与消费。
drought|A prolonged drought affected both crop yields and household water supplies, forcing authorities to reconsider how scarce water was allocated.|持续干旱影响了作物产量和家庭供水，迫使主管部门重新考虑如何分配稀缺水资源。
mitigate|Planting trees can help mitigate urban heat, but the effect depends on canopy coverage and where vulnerable residents actually spend time.|植树有助于缓解城市高温，但效果取决于树冠覆盖程度及易受影响居民实际活动的位置。
nutrition|School meals can improve children's nutrition when they provide a varied diet and are available to pupils who would otherwise miss lunch.|如果学校膳食提供多样化饮食，并覆盖原本可能吃不上午餐的学生，就可以改善儿童营养。
obesity|Policies addressing obesity may need to consider food prices and the built environment alongside information about individual choices.|应对肥胖的政策可能需要在宣传个人选择的同时，考虑食物价格和建成环境。
sedentary|Sedentary office work can be interrupted with short movement breaks, even when employees cannot leave the workplace for exercise.|即使员工不能离开工作场所锻炼，也可以用短暂活动间歇打断久坐的办公室工作。
chronic|People with chronic conditions may need coordinated support over many years rather than a single course of treatment.|患有慢性疾病的人可能需要多年协调的支持，而不只是一次疗程。
prevention|Investment in disease prevention may produce benefits gradually, which can make its value less visible than new hospital construction.|疾病预防投入的收益可能逐渐显现，因此其价值可能不如新建医院那么显眼。
diagnosis|An early diagnosis can open up treatment options, although its benefits depend on whether effective care is actually available.|早期诊断可以提供更多治疗选择，但其益处取决于是否真正有有效医疗可用。
urbanisation|Rapid urbanisation can increase pressure on housing and transport when public investment fails to keep pace with population growth.|当公共投资跟不上人口增长时，快速城市化会加大住房与交通压力。
infrastructure|Infrastructure investment needs to account for maintenance because a new facility is of limited value if it cannot operate reliably.|基础设施投资需要考虑维护，因为新设施如果不能可靠运作，其价值就很有限。
affordable housing|Affordable housing near employment centres can reduce long commutes, but the supply must remain accessible to lower-income residents.|就业中心附近的可负担住房可以减少长距离通勤，但这些住房必须持续向低收入居民开放。
congestion|Road congestion may return after extra lanes are added if easier driving encourages more people to travel by car.|如果驾驶变得更容易促使更多人开车出行，即使增加了车道，道路拥堵也可能再次出现。
commute|A shorter commute can leave workers more time for family responsibilities, even if their working hours remain unchanged.|即使工时不变，更短的通勤也能让员工有更多时间照顾家庭。
pedestrian|The design gives pedestrians a direct route to the station instead of requiring them to cross several busy roads.|这一设计为行人提供了直达车站的路线，无须穿过数条繁忙道路。
recruitment|The recruitment process was revised to assess relevant skills directly rather than relying mainly on the prestige of applicants' universities.|招聘流程被修改为直接评估相关技能，而不再主要依赖申请者毕业院校的声望。
productivity|Higher productivity does not always require longer working hours; reliable equipment and better coordination may reduce wasted effort.|提高生产率并不总需要延长工时；可靠设备和更好的协调可能减少无效付出。

flexibility|Greater flexibility in working hours can help employees manage caring responsibilities, provided that expectations about availability remain clear.|只要对员工何时应在线或到岗的要求仍然明确，更灵活的工时可以帮助他们安排照护责任。
inequality|Income inequality may persist even as average earnings rise, so the distribution of gains matters as much as the overall trend.|即使平均收入上升，收入不平等仍可能持续，因此收益如何分配与整体趋势同样重要。
inclusion|Social inclusion requires people to have meaningful opportunities to participate, rather than simply being invited to events they cannot access.|社会包容要求人们拥有真正的参与机会，而不只是被邀请参加他们无法参与的活动。

diversity|Diversity within a research team can broaden the questions it asks, but inclusive working practices are needed for different perspectives to be heard.|研究团队内部的多样性可以拓宽其提出的问题，但仍需要包容的工作方式，才能让不同观点被听见。

heritage|Local heritage includes everyday places and practices that residents value, as well as buildings officially recognised for their historical importance.|地方遗产既包括因历史重要性得到官方认可的建筑，也包括居民珍视的日常场所与实践。
migration|Migration patterns reflect employment opportunities and family connections, making it difficult to explain movement through income differences alone.|迁移模式反映就业机会和家庭联系，因此难以仅用收入差距解释人口流动。
demographic|Demographic change can alter demand for schools and healthcare, but national averages may conceal substantial local differences.|人口结构变化会改变对学校和医疗的需求，但全国平均值可能掩盖显著的地方差异。
cohesion|Community cohesion may strengthen when residents work on shared projects, particularly where they previously had few opportunities to meet.|居民共同参与项目时，社区凝聚力可能增强，尤其是在他们此前很少有机会见面时。

representation|Improving representation in local consultation requires reaching people whose working hours or language needs prevent attendance at formal meetings.|改善地方咨询中的代表性，需要接触那些因工时或语言需求而无法参加正式会议的人。
prejudice|Prejudice can influence hiring decisions even when employers believe they are judging candidates only on merit.|即使雇主认为自己只依据能力评价候选人，偏见仍可能影响招聘决策。
stereotype|A stereotype about older workers can lead employers to overlook relevant experience or assume that further training would be ineffective.|关于年长员工的刻板印象，可能使雇主忽视相关经验，或认定进一步培训没有效果。
expenditure|Household expenditure on transport increased after several bus routes were withdrawn and more residents had to rely on cars.|几条公交线路撤销后，更多居民不得不依赖汽车，家庭交通支出随之增加。
revenue|The council expected revenue from parking charges to fund maintenance, but usage was lower than forecast in the first year.|地方议会预期用停车收费收入支付维护，但第一年的使用量低于预测。

investment|Investment in public transport can benefit households without cars, although fares and service frequency determine whether those benefits are widely shared.|公共交通投资可以惠及无车家庭，但票价与班次频率决定这些收益能否被广泛分享。
inflation|If inflation outpaces wage growth, households may cut non-essential spending even while their nominal income continues to rise.|如果通胀快于工资增长，即使名义收入继续增加，家庭仍可能削减非必要支出。
allocation|The allocation of school funding should consider differences in need rather than assuming that equal amounts always produce equal opportunities.|学校资金分配应考虑需求差异，而不能假定相同金额总能带来平等机会。
demand|Demand for evening courses increased as more adults sought qualifications without interrupting their employment.|随着更多成年人希望在不中断就业的情况下取得资格，对晚间课程的需求上升。
supply|Expanding the supply of housing may ease pressure on rents, but the location and price of new homes also influence who benefits.|扩大住房供给可能缓解租金压力，但新住房的位置和价格也影响由谁获益。
consumption|Changes in household energy consumption reflected both higher prices and improvements in insulation, rather than a single change in behaviour.|家庭能源消费的变化既反映价格上涨，也反映保温改善，而不是单一的行为变化。
distribution|The distribution of income matters when evaluating living standards because an increase in the average can leave many households worse off.|评估生活水平时，收入分配很重要，因为平均收入增加时，许多家庭的状况仍可能恶化。
trade-off|There is a trade-off between providing more frequent bus services and keeping fares low when the transport budget is fixed.|交通预算固定时，增加公交班次与维持低票价之间存在权衡。
fluctuate|Visitor numbers fluctuate throughout the year, making it difficult for the museum to plan staffing solely on the basis of annual totals.|游客人数全年波动，使博物馆难以仅依据年度总量安排人员。
evidence|The available evidence suggests that the programme improved attendance, but it does not show whether learning outcomes also changed.|现有证据表明该计划改善了出勤，但不能说明学习成果是否也发生了变化。
hypothesis|The researchers tested the hypothesis that clearer route information would encourage more residents to use public transport.|研究人员检验了这样一个假设：更清晰的路线信息会鼓励更多居民使用公共交通。
variable|Income was included as a variable because it could affect both where participants lived and how often they visited green spaces.|收入被纳入变量，因为它可能同时影响参与者住在哪里，以及他们多常前往绿地。
sample|The sample included residents from several neighbourhoods, although people without internet access were less likely to take part.|样本包括几个街区的居民，但没有网络的人参与的可能性较低。
correlation|A correlation between screen time and poor sleep does not establish which factor came first or whether another factor influenced both.|屏幕使用时间与睡眠不佳之间的相关，并不能确定哪个因素先出现，也不能排除另一因素同时影响两者。

causation|The authors were careful to distinguish correlation from causation because their study observed existing behaviour rather than assigning an intervention.|作者谨慎区分相关与因果，因为他们的研究观察的是已有行为，而不是分配干预措施。
methodology|The methodology explains how participants were recruited and why certain responses were excluded, allowing readers to assess possible bias.|研究方法部分解释了如何招募参与者、为何排除某些回复，使读者能够评估可能的偏差。
proportion|The proportion of students studying part-time rose, even though the total number of part-time students remained almost unchanged.|尽管非全日制学生总人数几乎不变，其在学生中的比例仍然上升。
percentage point|The participation rate increased from 40% to 50%, a rise of ten percentage points rather than ten per cent.|参与率从百分之四十升至百分之五十，是增加了十个百分点，而不是增加百分之十。
evaluate|To evaluate the programme fairly, the researchers compared its costs and outcomes with those of a realistic alternative.|为公平评估该计划，研究人员把它的成本和结果与一个现实可行的替代方案进行了比较。
justify|The authority must justify the closure by explaining why the expected savings outweigh the loss of access for local residents.|主管部门必须解释为何预期节省的开支大于当地居民失去服务机会的损失，以说明关闭决定的合理性。
implication|One implication of the findings is that providing information alone may be insufficient when people also face practical barriers.|研究发现的一个含义是，当人们还面临实际障碍时，仅提供信息可能不足以解决问题。
assumption|The proposal rests on the assumption that most residents can travel to the new centre, which may not hold for people without cars.|该提案建立在大多数居民能前往新中心的假设上，而这一假设对没有汽车的人未必成立。
constraint|Limited staff time was a major constraint, so the team focused on changes that could be maintained after the initial funding ended.|员工时间有限是一项主要约束，因此团队重点考虑了在初期资金结束后仍能维持的改变。
feasibility|The feasibility study considered maintenance skills and seasonal demand as well as the cost of building the facility.|可行性研究除了设施建设成本，还考虑了维护技能和季节性需求。
perspective|From a resident's perspective, a technically efficient service may still be inconvenient if its opening hours conflict with working patterns.|从居民角度看，一项技术上高效的服务，如果开放时间与工作安排冲突，仍可能不便。
proportionate|A proportionate response should address the seriousness of the risk without imposing restrictions that offer little additional protection.|适度的应对措施应针对风险的严重程度，而不施加几乎不能增加保护的限制。
